examples.title: Example 1: Understanding Hit Test Effects for Block and Transparent Modes
examples.description: This example demonstrates the hit test effects of Block and Transparent hit test modes by setting different HitTestMode values.

examples.title: Example 2: Understanding the Hit Test Effect When the Hit Test Type is BLOCK_HIERARCHY
examples.description: This example demonstrates the hit test effect when the hit test type is set to BLOCK_HIERARCHY, supported since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 3: Understanding the Hit Test Effect When the Hit Test Type is BLOCK_DESCENDANTS
examples.description: This example demonstrates the hit test effect when the hit test type is set to BLOCK_DESCENDANTS, supported since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 4: Understanding the Hit Test Effect When Multiple Nodes Overlap in the Stack Component
examples.description: This example demonstrates the hit testing effect when multiple nodes have overlapping touch areas within a Stack component. If HitTestMode is set to None, the overlapping background area cannot respond to hit testing. The background area respond to hit testing only when the attribute is set to Transparent.
